description: List an event's published exhibitor booths, with provider profile links when available. Use an event_slug from list_events; get_event gives event details. Category and text filters combine with AND. Returns event, page, total_items, total_pages and items; defaults to page 1 with 20 booths in published order. Unknown events return a not-found error; no matching booths returns empty items. Confirm booth assignments with the exhibitor.

category.description: Case-insensitive exact organiser category label, up to 80 characters (e.g. Payment). Omit or leave empty for all categories.

event_slug.description: Exact event slug returned by list_events or search; copy it rather than guessing. Use the lowercase hyphenated identifier (1-120 characters), not a title or full URL.

limit.description: Booths per page, from 1 to 50 (default 20). Keep filters and limit unchanged while paging through total_pages.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1, maximum 500). Keep filters and limit unchanged while paging; stop at total_pages. A page beyond the results returns an empty items array.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring in exhibitor name or booth, up to 200 characters. Omit or leave empty for all booths; combines with category.

name: list_exhibitors
title: List event exhibitors
